definitions.usage: be set on edge, be blunt.
definitions.full: H6949. qahah [ קָהָה ] verb be blunt, dull (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic קְהָא , ); — Qal Imperfect 3feminine plural תִּקְהֶינָה Jer 31:29 : Jeremiah 30 Ezek 18:2 (all of teeth). Pi`el in sense of Qal: Perfect 3masculine singular קֵהָה Eccl 10:10 if the iron be blunt .
